name: 🫧🫧: She’s way too positive. Bet she’s never struggled.

music.title: Snap (low and slow) by rosa linn

lines.ref:
🫧🫧: She’s way too positive.
Bet she’s never struggled.

15 years old

worked at a gas station for living

16 years old

left my hometown island alone

16 years old

one-bedroom ✨
started living alone

17 years old

Hotel banquet server for living cost

17 years old

second job at a PC cafe for tuition

17 years old

prepared
for college entrance exam,too

17 years old

Studied whenever I could

18 years old

i got into college-international trade

18 years old

i got into college-international trade

And I worked at Subway,too

18 years old
paying for college on my own
wasn’t possible.
so I took a break from school.

19 years old

I decided to save up a lot of money
to start studying again

19 years old

two jobs again. 60-70 hrs/week.
McDonald’s +cafe

20 years old

I ended up going full-time at the cafe
worked 72 hrs/week
my latte art!!

21 years old

my birthday.
and I worked till 5AM at the cafe

21 years old

I couldn’t stop studying.
It felt like my life would stop if I did

21 years old

cringe hahaha

22 years old

finally quit working.
focused only
on entrance exam prep for a year

I was genuinely grateful for everything!!

23 years old

my first year in nursing school❤️

23 years old

my first year in nursing school❤️

I got these grades working at MacDonald’s
20-30 hrs/week!!

24 years old

my second year in nursing school❤️
volunteering

24 years old

my second year in nursing school❤️
work

work
work

work
work
work

24 years old

and I got a merit scholarship
every semester ✨❤️

25 years old

the darkest year of my life.
severe stalking and death threats
from my ex

25 years old

the darkest year of my life.
severe stalking and death threats
from my ex

It became a criminal case.
months of police investigations.
I lived in fear-even daily life felt terrifying.
and actually I still live in fear.

25 years old

the darkest year of my life.
severe stalking and death threats
from my ex

so I decided to leave Korea
after graduation
and become a nurse abroad!

25 years old

Took a leave from school
to do English study abroad.

SAVED UP!
LG factory. two shifts. two months!!

26 years old

I don’t just SAY IT!!
I do it always!!

26 years old

Back to school

2025
27 years old

my 4th year in nursing!

YES!
I’m way too positive!

YES!
I’m way too positive!

PLEASE Don’t give up.

YES!
I’m way too positive!

PLEASE Don’t give up.

YOU CAN MAKE IT HAPPEN!!

special: A sequence of real archive photos and camera roll screenshots spanning ages 15-27 documenting specific past jobs, study notes, transcripts, and certificates
audit.notes: This format relies on hyper-specific authentic proof from the creator's personal archives over a 10-year span (uniform mirror selfies from teen jobs, handwritten timecards, police report texts, study notes with calluses, transcripts, and nursing credentials). Generic lifestyle b-roll cannot recreate the authentic chronological personal narrative.
audit.summary: A chronological photo and screenshot slideshow documenting the creator's past decade of struggles (working multiple jobs, paying tuition alone, stalking trauma, nursing school) to prove her optimism was earned through hardship.
